description: Adaptive competition training system for the MAA AMC 10, covering Algebra, Geometry, Number Theory, and Combinatorics with AIME qualification cutoff benchmarks.
scoring_rule: 6 points per correct answer, 1.5 points per blank, 0 points per wrong answer. Max 150 points. AIME benchmark ~100 points.

stages.desc_en: Stratified cross-domain test across Algebra, Geometry, Number Theory, and Combinatorics.
stages.desc_zh: 跨四大模块分层抽样，测出代数、几何、数论、组合的初始基准短板。

stages.desc_en: Deep dive into core theorems (Vieta, Power of Point, Modulo, Stars & Bars) with distractor reasoning.
stages.desc_zh: 针对核心定理（韦达、圆幂、同余模运算、隔板法）展开图解精练与错因剖析。

stages.desc_en: Bayesian-smoothed reinforcement eliminating calculation pitfalls and perimeter traps until cleared.
stages.desc_zh: 错题本贝叶斯加权攻坚，消灭计算陷阱与边界极端情况直至完全掌握。

stages.desc_en: Strict 75-minute 25-question simulation benchmarking against the 100-pt AIME qualification cutoff.
stages.desc_zh: 严格75分钟25题全真模拟，对标约100分（67%）AIME晋级资格线与考后全回复盘。

stages.desc_en: Personalized test sets targeting historical weak domains for high-confidence contest day success.
stages.desc_zh: 自适应个性化套卷，针对弱项模块智能动态配比，冲刺AIME晋级资格。
